summary.text: Joe Hogan is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 142 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Listed on Ballotpedia as Joseph Hogan, he previously worked as a program director at the Bucks County Redevelopment Authority.

paragraphs.text: Joe Hogan lives in Langhorne, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Conwell-Egan Catholic High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Pennsylvania State University in 2010 and 2018, respectively, and as of 2022 was completing a J.D. at Temple University.
His career experience includes working as a staff member for Congressman Mike Fitzpatrick and as a program director at the Bucks County Redevelopment Authority.
Hogan assumed office on December 1, 2022, succeeding Frank Farry.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Children & Youth and Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure, where he was secretary.
